$comment: Components without automated axe coverage. Currently empty — coverage is 145/145 and this list may ONLY grow with a documented reason. Every entry needs `component`, `rule`, `reason` and `revisit`; `bun run check:a11y` rejects an entry that omits any of them, because an exemption without a reason is a defect with a label on it. To remove an entry: add src/components/<category>/__tests__/<name>.test.tsx (or render it in src/__tests__/a11y.test.tsx), then delete it here.

$schema.rule: what is exempted — an axe rule id, or "coverage" for a missing test
$schema.revisit: what has to happen for this to go away
